caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**:
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" button
- **Center**:
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 00:47"
  - Notification bell icon
- **Right Side**:
  - Network icon (showing "Wired Connected")
  - Sound icon (volume control)
  - Power button icon

## System Menu (Dropdown)
- **Visible on the top right**:
  - **Volume Control**:
    - Speaker icon
    - Horizontal volume slider (orange, set to maximum)
  - **Network Status**:
    - Wired network icon
    - Text: "Wired Connected"
    - Right arrow (indicating submenu)
  - **Power Mode**:
    - Battery icon
    - Text: "Balanced"
    - Right arrow (indicating submenu)
  - **Settings**:
    - Gear icon
    - Text: "Settings"
  - **Lock**:
    - Lock icon
    - Text: "Lock"
  - **Power Off / Log Out**:
    - Power icon
    - Text: "Power Off / Log Out"
    - Right arrow (indicating submenu)

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**:
  - Gradient wallpaper transitioning from dark purple to red
- **Desktop Icons**:
  - Single icon at bottom right: "Home" folder icon with label "Home"

## Left Sidebar (Dock)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - **Activities** (icon: grid)
  - **Files** (icon: folder)
  - **Web Browser** (icon: Chrome)
  - **Email Client** (icon: Thunderbird)
  - **IDE** (icon: Visual Studio Code)
  - **Media Player** (icon: VLC)
  - **Document Editor** (icon: LibreOffice Writer)
  - **Spreadsheet** (icon: LibreOffice Calc)
  - **Presentation** (icon: LibreOffice Impress)
  - **Graphics Editor** (icon: GIMP)
  - **Terminal** (icon: terminal)
  - **App Store** (icon: Ubuntu Software)
  - **Help** (icon: question mark)
  - **Settings** (icon: gear)
  - **Trash** (icon: trash can)
  - **Grid of Apps** (icon: 3x3 grid)

## File Manager Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - "Home" label
  - Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Navigation Bar**:
  - Back and Forward arrows
  - Home icon
  - Search icon
  - More options (three dots)
  - View options (list, grid, etc.)
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - "Recent"
  - "Starred"
  - "Home" (selected)
  - "Desktop"
  - "Documents"
  - "Downloads"
  - "Music"
  - "Pictures"
  - "Videos"
  - "Trash"
  - "Other Locations"
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - Visible items:
    - Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures, Public
    - server, snap, Templates, Videos
    - .cache, .config, .gnupg, .ipython, .lessht, .local, .mozilla
    - .pki, .profile, .selected_editor, .ssh
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful, thunderbird, .var
    - .viminfo, .vscode
    - requirement.txt, .bash_history, .bash_logout, .bashrc

## Settings Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - "Settings" label
  - Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Search Bar**:
  - Search icon
- **Left Sidebar (Categories)**:
  - "Power" (selected, highlighted in orange)
  - "Displays"
  - "Mouse & Touchpad"
  - "Keyboard"
  - "Printers"
- **Right Content Area**:
  - "Power" section
  - Text: "nce and power usage." (repeated multiple times)
  - Dropdown menu: "Never" (selected)
  - Text: "period of inactivity."
  - Toggle switch: "Off" (selected)
